Boggard Dreadknot.name: Boggard Dreadknot
Boggard Dreadknot.description: The boggard cavalry wields clubs as they ride giant frogs into battle, often ranging out of their swamp homelands to strike fear into the hearts of their enemies.

YIQIuTTrnRTLS3kt.name: Batrachian Blitz
YIQIuTTrnRTLS3kt.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The boggard dreadknot pummels each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] with their clubs, with a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(3d6+10)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(4d6+13)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

oJPw0n4DdxpkVNlK.name: Chorus of Croaks
oJPw0n4DdxpkVNlK.description: The boggard dreadknot unleashes a chorus of terrifying croaks. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save; those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

P7BbgkbC8XZ9bU1X.name: Javelin Barrage
P7BbgkbC8XZ9bU1X.description: The dreadknot draws javelins and launches a coordinated barrage. This barrage is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 30 feet that deals @Damage[4d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the dreadknot is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

3B62IJtohsC40PBN.name: Mounted Troop
3B62IJtohsC40PBN.description: Effects that target only animals or only humanoids may not work on the boggard dreadknot, subject to the GM's discretion.

x9EwNYVrQ0Hm6zKF.name: Swamp Passage
x9EwNYVrQ0Hm6zKF.description: A boggard dreadknot ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

FLM2nudormV08hBs.name: Tongue Lashing
FLM2nudormV08hBs.description: The dreadknot's giant frogs lash out at each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] with their tongues, requiring them to succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. A creature grabbed in this way isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move more than 15 feet from the dreadknot. A creature can sever one of the tongues with a Strike against AC 25 that deals at least 15 slashing damage. This doesn't deal damage to the dreadknot.

0.label: to High Jump or Long Jump

Drake Flight.name: Drake Flight
Drake Flight.description: Though drakes from different biomes rarely interact with one another due to geographical distance, a powerful creature, ancient artifact, or natural catastrophe could bring together multiple types of drakes into a single terrifying, living catastrophe. Such a flight can be a terror to behold on the battlefield.

WWmwctWaT06hNzMR.name: Draconic Onslaught
WWmwctWaT06hNzMR.description:
The drakes frenzy, lashing out with fangs and tails. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] attempts a @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[2d8[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(3d8+10)[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(4d8+14)[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage

FUmBqO0V8PxJ39YL.name: Drake Breath
FUmBqO0V8PxJ39YL.description: Certain drakes within the flight bring their breath weapon (or similar ability) to bear, exhaling energy that explodes in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] within 120 feet. This explosion deals @Damage[5d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage (acid, cold, fire, or poison damage); the ability gains the corresponding trait. The drake flight can't choose the same damage type until it uses this ability with a different damage type. When the drakes are reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:10].

hL2HetxBFbq6nqu3.name: Speed Surge
hL2HetxBFbq6nqu3.description:
Frequency three times per day

Effect The drake flight Strides or Flies twice.

4PScM2COzIjHjq0W.name: Dirty Tricks
4PScM2COzIjHjq0W.description: The ratfolk feint and trip up their foes in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], attempting a single @Check[thievery|against:reflex] check and comparing the result to each target's Reflex DC. On a success, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical success) until they take an Interact action to remove the condition.

PFRTcxVCSgkl4Vru.name: Poisoned Bolts
PFRTcxVCSgkl4Vru.description: The shank squad draws hand crossbows to fire poisoned bolts in a volley. This volley is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 60 feet that deals @Damage[2d6[piercing],2d6[poison]|options:area-damage]{2d6 piercing damage and 2d6 poison damage} with a @Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|options:area-effect] save. When the shank squad is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

XmcGqmrImLqgyZm4.name: Shank 'Em
XmcGqmrImLqgyZm4.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The shank squad makes a coordinated attack with shivs and daggers against each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d6[slashing],1d4[precision]|options:area-damage]{1d6 slashing damage and 1d4 precision damage}

2 @Damage[(2d6+3)[slashing],2d4[precision]|options:area-damage]{2d6+3 slashing damage and 2d4 precision damage}

3 @Damage[(2d6+6)[slashing],3d4[precision]|options:area-damage]{2d6+6 slashing damage and 3d4 precision damage}

Vanth Guardian Flock.name: Vanth Guardian Flock
Vanth Guardian Flock.description: Vanth psychopomps are eternal guardians of the cycle of life and death. When souls are threatened by fiends or other malevolent forces, they gather together to cut the threat down.

MsKH9CcQ2FUFYARf.name: Reactive Relocation
MsKH9CcQ2FUFYARf.description:
Trigger A creature hits the guardian flock with an attack roll

Effect After the attack roll is resolved, the troop pools dimensional magic to rapidly change their position. They cast 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate}, except their range is limited to 40 feet.

H19kpPq2dPnbnx8y.name: Guardians' Curse
H19kpPq2dPnbnx8y.description:
Frequency three times per day

Effect The guardian flock bestows a curse upon all enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] by touching them with their scythes. Each affected creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33|options:area-effect] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Guardians' Curse for 24 hours.

Success The target feels a momentary shudder of doom and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute by the distracting sensation.

Failure The target becomes morose and glum as it accepts its own inevitable fate. For 1 hour, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}. Each time the target gains the dying condition, the stupefied condition value increases by 1, to a maximum value of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect is permanent.

Czd11iaEfPW4tn8T.name: Harvest the Wicked
Czd11iaEfPW4tn8T.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The vanths swing their scythes in a coordinated melee attack. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions. The slashing damage is treated as adamantine, cold iron, and silver.

1 @Damage[(1d10+1)[slashing],1d6[untyped]|options:area-damage,item:rune:property:ghost-touch]{1d10+1 slashing damage plus 1d6 shepherd's touch}

2 @Damage[(2d10+3)[slashing],3d6[untyped]|options:area-damage,item:rune:property:ghost-touch]{2d10+3 slashing damage plus 3d6 shepherd's touch}

3 @Damage[(2d10+7)[slashing],4d6[untyped]|options:area-damage,item:rune:property:ghost-touch]{2d10+7 slashing damage plus 4d6 shepherd's touch}

5KyfdWPCoXhy15Im.name: Shepherd’s Touch
5KyfdWPCoXhy15Im.description: The physical damage dealt by the guardian flock's Harvest the Wicked ability is treated as coming from a weapon with a ghost touch property rune. In addition, the vanths deal the listed damage as void damage to living creatures or vitality damage to undead.

Mitflit Vermin Cavalry.name: Mitflit Vermin Cavalry
Mitflit Vermin Cavalry.description: Though mitflits are known as cowardly gremlins, they can be urged into an aggressive fervor by the right leader. Mounted on giant ticks, centipedes, and other verminous arthropods, these mitflits overcome their self-loathing to take the fight to their enemies.

pdDjyRubh4JykjK1.name: Crawling Stabs
pdDjyRubh4JykjK1.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The mitflits thrust with their shortswords, coordinated with bites from their giant vermin mounts. All enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d6+4)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(2d6+8)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

P6s1HQwegXyFaIih.name: Leaping Charge
P6s1HQwegXyFaIih.description: The mitflit vermin cavalry Leaps up to 30 feet. If it moves at least 15 feet, the cavalry deals @Damage[(2d6+4)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] save) to each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] at the end of its movement.

AYEfCOwUzittbzFm.name: Mounted Troop
AYEfCOwUzittbzFm.description: Effects that target only animals or only humanoids may not work on the mitflit vermin cavalry, subject to the GM's discretion.

9w4raGfyxBVkVKDT.name: Vengeful Wrath
9w4raGfyxBVkVKDT.description: As long as it's not frightened, the mitflit vermin cavalry gains a +2 status bonus to the DC of its Crawling Stabs ability against creatures that have previously damaged or tormented it.

Boggard Scouting Party.name: Boggard Scouting Party
Boggard Scouting Party.description: Boggard scouting parties run ahead of other boggard troops to get the lay of the land. They sometimes engage if they think they can quickly vanquish an enemy force.

6n1YNpA9sckKPpwJ.name: Chorus of Croaks
6n1YNpA9sckKPpwJ.description: The boggard scouting party unleashes a chorus of terrifying croaks. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save; those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

qaBL38g5CJeGHGUZ.name: Coordinated Tongue Pull
qaBL38g5CJeGHGUZ.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Several boggards use their tongues to grapple an enemy within 10 feet to pull them closer. The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save. On a failure, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and pulled 5 feet closer to the scouting party. A creature grabbed in this way isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move more than 10 feet from the scouting party. A creature can sever one of the tongues with a Strike against AC 21 that deals at least 5 slashing damage. This doesn't damage the scouting party.

HbU9kLWy2ILILzTj.name: Morningstar Massacre
HbU9kLWy2ILILzTj.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The boggards execute coordinated melee attacks against each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d6+7)[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(2d6+11)[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage

qt8qxclrefUDCgL5.name: Sling Barrage
qt8qxclrefUDCgL5.description: The dreadknot draws and loads slings to launch a coordinated barrage. This barrage is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 50 feet that deals @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the scouting party is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

VBT6H5puqPRiwRvD.name: Swamp Passage
VBT6H5puqPRiwRvD.description: A boggard scouting party ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

Gargoyle Wing.name: Gargoyle Wing
Gargoyle Wing.description: Normally solitary beasts that lurk in abandoned temples and other structures that afford them a place to hide among appropriately monstrous statuary, gargoyles occasionally band together to hunt challenging prey or simply to take communal pleasure in slaughtering the defenseless. Called wings, these groupings are usually short-lived, though that matters little to those who fall victim to their predations in the meantime.

scPsVJgp3B51KjMF.name: Death From Above
scPsVJgp3B51KjMF.description:
Trigger The gargoyle wing is Flying, and a creature moves into an adjacent square below it

Effect The gargoyle wing swoops down with their talons. The triggering creature takes @Damage[(2d8+9)[slashing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save).

grfypKAmBW7H9dWz.name: Catch and Release
grfypKAmBW7H9dWz.description: The gargoyle wing attempts an Athletics checks to [[/act grapple]], comparing the result to the Fortitude DC of a number of Large or smaller creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] equal to the gargoyle wing's remaining number of segments, then Flies up to 40 feet, bringing any successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} creatures along, and Releases them.

FRbuLqAKh0PNhfBK.name: Raking Swoop
FRbuLqAKh0PNhfBK.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The gargoyle wing rips and tears with their stony talons at each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect] save). The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d8+2)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+9)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(3d8+11)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

Dwarf Longshot Squad.name: Dwarf Longshot Squad
Dwarf Longshot Squad.description: While many dwarves train to master hammers and shields, others seek to become masters of ranged weapons, usually sturdy and dwarven-built crossbows. Dwarven armies employ longshot squads as the first line of defense, especially outside of cramped tunnels and subterranean caverns.

EONX1OgwRhf35gSm.name: Bolts from the Blue
EONX1OgwRhf35gSm.description: The dwarven longshots reload their crossbows, then launch a ranged attack in the form of a volley. This volley is a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] within 120 feet that deals @Damage[6d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] saving throw. When the dwarven longshot squad is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:10].

cE3nGCXUZ43jjTq2.name: Brandish Bayonets!
cE3nGCXUZ43jjTq2.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Using blades attached to their crossbows, the dwarven longshots engages in a coordinated melee attack against enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d8+2)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+11)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(3d8+13)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

se3I5XIArIcKZkGt.name: Hampering Fusillade
se3I5XIArIcKZkGt.description:
The dwarven longshots fire dozens of bolts in quick succession to slow down advancing enemies. Each creature in a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] within 120 feet must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed for 1 minute. Spending an Interact action to remove the bolts ends this penalty.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.3bAtqn2WPSqxCYPY]{Effect: Hampering Fusillade}

First-Class Infantry.name: First-Class Infantry
First-Class Infantry.description: Soldiers who participate in multiple campaigns of war gain the experience necessary to become their military's finest fighting forces. First-class infantry troops are deployed on battlefields where winning the day is of the utmost importance.

SPbz9zTjxVJ1NfTI.name: No Retreat
SPbz9zTjxVJ1NfTI.description: These soldiers have been extensively trained to hold their ground no matter the situation. If any effect would force the first-class infantry to move, reduce the distance by 10 feet. Any time they would be affected by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition, the first-class infantry is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for the same duration.

bDE87FD5U7tvqvaA.name: Bolt Salvo
bDE87FD5U7tvqvaA.description: The first-class infantry draws, loads, and shoots a salvo from their crossbows. The salvo is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 120 feet that deals @Damage[4d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the first-class infantry is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

B4GNybKzTfM43wAU.name: Clash of Steel
B4GNybKzTfM43wAU.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The first-class infantry attacks each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:29|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(2d6+1)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(4d6+10)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(4d6+18)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

IVKVwDUUSE2SgKLv.name: Drilled in Formations
IVKVwDUUSE2SgKLv.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The first-class infantry uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.USyDPcSdzcm024zT]{Change Formation}. An first-class infantry unit typically knows the marching column and wedge formations.

vklePDp4ChdoOuoW.name: First-class Charge
vklePDp4ChdoOuoW.description: The first-class infantry rushes forward with a hunger for battle. They Stride up to twice their Speed. At the end of their movement, each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] takes @Damage[(2d6+5)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage, with a @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save.

Redcap Brigade.name: Redcap Brigade
Redcap Brigade.description: Redcaps are sadistic fey known for their merciless bloodlust. When they gather into troops, they goad each other to greater heights of violence.

KydKNZNQcPHQ3kkf.name: Divine Revulsion
KydKNZNQcPHQ3kkf.description:
If a redcap brigade sees a creature brandish a religious symbol of a deity (which requires an Interact action by that creature) or cast a divine spell while wearing a religious symbol, the troop must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save. They then become temporarily immune to all brandished religious symbols for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The troop is unaffected.

Success The troop is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The troop is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The troop is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

wPjzApQ4hGBMlw0E.name: Blood Soak
wPjzApQ4hGBMlw0E.description:
Trigger The redcap brigade loses its first segment, causes another troop to lose its first segment, or is otherwise exposed to copious amounts of blood

Effect The redcap brigade gains a status bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute. The bonus is +2 if they spend one action on Bloody Reaping, +6 if they spend two actions, or +8 if they spend 3 actions. They gain a +4 status bonus to damage rolls with Bowl Over and Stomp.

r5WgyRN7xTAUNicy.name: Bloody Reaping
r5WgyRN7xTAUNicy.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The redcaps in the brigade wildly swing their halberds and sickles at each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10], with a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d10+2)[slashing]|options:area-damage,bloody-reaping-one]

2 @Damage[(2d10+9)[slashing]|options:area-damage,bloody-reaping-two]

3 @Damage[(3d10+10)[slashing]|options:area-damage,bloody-reaping-three]

v9h1oFMfGfVN2Qee.name: Bowl Over and Stomp
v9h1oFMfGfVN2Qee.description:
The redcap brigade Strides; they can pass through spaces of Medium or smaller creatures, but can't end their movement in them. All enemies whose spaces the redcap brigade passed through take @Damage[4d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,bowl-ower-and-stomp] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26|options:area-effect,inflicts:prone] save. Bowl Over and Stomp damages each creature only once.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage. If it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, it also takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is knocked prone, and takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is knocked prone, and takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

I03lQeMuxhRMsRtc.name: Deadly Swipes
I03lQeMuxhRMsRtc.description:
Trigger The redcap brigade drops a creature to 0 Hit Points with Bloody Reaping

Effect The redcap brigade performs an additional one-action Bloody Reaping, ignoring the once per round frequency limitation. This does not deal damage to the triggering creature.

Viking Guard.name: Viking Guard
Viking Guard.description: Battle-tested Ulfen barbarians, hunters, and warriors gather into an elite fighting unit who specialize in offering protection to their leaders in battle as well as protecting those who can afford their services. Traveling far and wide, single troops or entire companies can easily find work based on their reputations, from serving as bodyguards in small private armies to taking on specialized jobs.

VqEamdyLNKS5oVeS.name: +2 status to all saves vs. fear

nip3rJMlKAmiJXIk.name: Sacrifice
nip3rJMlKAmiJXIk.description:
Requirements The viking guard has a charge, and that creature is adjacent to the viking guard

Trigger The viking guard's charge takes Hit Point damage

Effect The viking guard's charge takes half damage, and the viking guard takes the remainder of the damage.

2yhFRocgioO4honN.name: Berserker Strikes
2yhFRocgioO4honN.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Battle axes in hand, the viking guard engages in a coordinated melee attack against enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d8+3)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+12)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(3d8+15)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

dmX23IiV8D4OzC5m.name: Guard Charge
dmX23IiV8D4OzC5m.description:
The viking guard designates an ally it can see to be its charge. The charge gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC, Reflex saves, and saves against fear when they are adjacent to the viking guard. Further, this allows the viking guard to use its Sacrifice and Shield Wall actions. A viking guard can have only one charge at a time, and if it designates a new charge, the old one loses all benefits. If the viking guard's charge is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the viking guard must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:30] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}; this is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.qTbVcHLfFDuyJTTG]{Effect: Guard Charge}

kQKdy0Cda3omnspU.name: Shield Wall
kQKdy0Cda3omnspU.description:
Requirements The viking guard has a charge, and that creature is adjacent to the viking guard

Effect Raising shields, the viking guard Strides up to twice its Speed as it protects its charge. The viking guard gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against reactions triggered by this movement. The viking guard's charge can Stride the same distance as a reaction, moving with the troop to maintain the bonuses from Guard Charge during this movement.

Scamp Whirlwind.name: Scamp Whirlwind
Scamp Whirlwind.description: In general, all elemental scamps are a bit mischievous, and equally as likely to gather in masses to wreak (often accidental) havoc.

a1S8MIzlSbM14TJF.name: Fog Vision

Clockwork Runner Pack.name: Clockwork Runner Pack
Clockwork Runner Pack.description: Clockwork runners are units build for speed. Mimicking large cats, they sacrifice sturdiness for agility. Runners provide excellent battlefield control by speedily traversing diverse terrain types, able to cut off enemy units and provide covering fire for allies with their built-in crossbows. As clockworks, they do need to be rewound, making them less ideal for longer deployments.

IWRYdtXAJ49GqLfB.name: Wind-Up
IWRYdtXAJ49GqLfB.description:
48 hours, [[/act disable-device dc=19]], standy

For a clockwork to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for the listed amount of time, usually 24 hours, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. Some clockworks' abilities require them to spend some of their remaining operational time. They can't spend more than they have and shut down immediately once they have 0 time remaining. If it's unclear when a clockwork was last wound, most clockwork keepers wind all their clockworks at a set time, typically 8 a.m.

A clockwork that lists standby in its wind-up entry can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A creature can attempt to Disable a Device to wind a clockwork down (with a DC listed in the wind-up entry). For each success, the clockwork loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the clockwork is in standby mode.

Hh1zN6n8JRhOzsdT.name: Fire Crossbows
Hh1zN6n8JRhOzsdT.description: The clockwork runners reload the crossbows built onto their backs, then launch a ranged attack in the form of a volley. This volley is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 120 feet that deals @Damage[2d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the clockwork runners are reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

Gnome Cannon Corps.name: Gnome Cannon Corps
Gnome Cannon Corps.description: Inventive gnomes blend engineering and fey magic to create wondrous cannons, whose colorful blasts dazzle foes while creating areas of warped terrain. Only the cleverest generals understand how to use cannon corps to great advantage in unconventional warfare.

CEKjsBaoB9qScWqZ.name: Arcane Explosion
CEKjsBaoB9qScWqZ.description: Aiming the gnome cannons toward the enemy, loading them, and firing them requires the troop's full attention. The cannons fire a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] of bright magic within 200 feet that deals @Damage[(2d12+2)[force]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|options:area-effect,light,visual] save). A creature that fails their save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round; this is a light and visual effect. The area of the explosion seems to twist and ripple for 1 minute afterward. A creature that attempts to move through the space must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:22] save or treat the area as difficult terrain; this is an illusion and visual effect.

PVMF2htb8MLPe6yb.description:

Clockwork Infantry.description: With each unit being 500 pounds of metal and magic, a clockwork infantry is a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. Needing no food, shelter, or rest and feeling no pain, clockwork infantry can advance where living units have great trouble. With no morale that can be broken or minds that can be beguiled, they patrol without stopping and show no mercy. The only drawback is the need to wind them more often than simpler clockwork mechanics.

Sinswarm.name: Sinswarm
Sinswarm.description: Sinspawn, monstrosities of twisted humanoid flesh, were created ages ago by the runelord Alaznist to serve as shock troops. Hateful even toward their own kind, sinspawn usually band together only in small, isolated cults, although powerful beings are occasionally able to coerce greater numbers of these slavering horrors to join forces as uniquely bloodthirsty and destructive mobs.

Animated Army.name: Animated Army
Animated Army.description: Animated statues usually appear in pairs or alone, hiding in plain sight among the other decor. Occasionally, a creator will fashion dozens of animated statues to serve as a nigh-unstoppable fighting force that doesn't complain or tire.
Animated Army.hpdetails: (4 segments); Thresholds 120 (4 segments); Thresholds 80 (3 segments), 40 (2 segments)

Cd6eDbFtKZ0Y74bp.description: Like normal objects, the animated statues of the animated army have Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage the animated army takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated army is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks, removing the Hardness and reducing its Armor Class to 23.

Goblin Rabble.description: Goblins lack the organization and discipline of their hobgoblin cousins but often more than make up for it with guile. The goblin rabble hamstring and hobble as many enemies as possible. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:18] save.

Omox Slime Pool.name: Omox Slime Pool
Omox Slime Pool.description: Omoxes are the embodiment of pollution and filth. While they have no true anatomy, they tend to take on mocking humanoid forms—though this distinction is difficult to spot when omoxes gather in large groups as part of an attacking force. Such a group often looks like a single roiling mass of slime with multiple torsos jutting up in a military formation.

2T2SRX4O8jOjVEoq.description: Omoxes embody filth, and they find the concept of cleanliness abhorrent. An omox slime pool subjected to an effect that cleans them takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage. They also take this damage the first time each round a creature damaged by an omox slime pool spends actions cleaning off the resultant filth.

Wolf Pack.description: Though wolf packs can be a menace to farming communities that rely on livestock, they prefer not to go after humanoids or other dangerous foes. However, hungry packs don't have the luxury of being cautious.

Orc raiders take the duty of carrying their hold's banner into combat with deadly seriousness and will gladly risk grievous injuries to keep their hold's standard flying high.

Mqkq79UBprlR4QUI.description:
The orc raiding party is about to lose a segment due to passing a Hit Point threshold

Effect The dying orc raiders lash out as they fall. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] takes @Damage[(1d6+2)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] save); this occurs before the raiding party loses a segment.

JmphMuXffisMi4gh.name: Break Through
JmphMuXffisMi4gh.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The orc raiders exploit a gap in enemy lines. The orc raiding party Strides twice; it can pass through spaces of Medium or smaller creatures but can't end its movement in them. All enemies whose spaces the orc raiding party passed through or were adjacent to at any point during their movement take @Damage[(1d6+2)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:forced-movement] save). A creature who critically fails this save is also pushed 5 feet away from the orc raiding party. Break Through damages each creature only once.

RfgBo9ONJcGFGDAH.name: Iron Rain
RfgBo9ONJcGFGDAH.description: The orc raiders launch a multitude of javelins at foes in a deadly volley. This volley is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 30 feet that deals @Damage[3d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] save. When the orc raiding party is reduced to 2 or fewer segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

pn0H1cy7HVHZUeAM.name: Rip Them Up
pn0H1cy7HVHZUeAM.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The orc raiders batter all enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] with coordinated knuckle dagger strikes (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d6+2)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(3d6+7)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

Giant Ant Army.name: Giant Ant Army
Giant Ant Army.description: Like their tiny counterparts, colonies of giant ants often form vast armies that launch regular campaigns into the lands surrounding their nests to forage for food and expand their territory. Though their primary targets are usually rival colonies, a giant ant army that happens upon a humanoid settlement will not hesitate to overrun and strip it of resources to bring back to their queen, taking a particular interest in the settlement's former inhabitants.

0GB6weL7oSMiYNhj.name: Giant Ant Venom
0GB6weL7oSMiYNhj.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d10[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} (1 round)

yA8PCCPpx4NOi1T8.name: Grasping Mandibles
yA8PCCPpx4NOi1T8.description:
Requirements The giant ant army's last action was a Mandible Frenzy that at least one creature failed their save against or the giant ant army has at least one creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect If used after Grasping Mandibles, the giant ant army can attempt an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]], comparing the result to the Fortitude DC of each creature who failed its saving throw, up to as many creatures as the giant ant army has remaining segments. The giant any army can instead use Grasping Mandibles to choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining to automatically extend that condition to the end of the army's next turn.

AUF1bsMkqxZPLcoF.name: Haul Away
AUF1bsMkqxZPLcoF.description:
Requirements The giant ant army has at least one creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}

Effect The army Strides up to its Speed, carrying any restrained creatures with it. If the creature is Gargantuan, the giant ant army is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered}.

sc3x5FE9ukgewtV4.name: Mandible Frenzy
sc3x5FE9ukgewtV4.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The army makes a savage bite attack against each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|options:area-effect] save). The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d8[slashing]|options:area-damage,grasping-mandibles] damage plus Grasping Mandibles

2 @Damage[(2d8+6)[slashing]|options:area-damage,grasping-mandibles] damage plus Grasping Mandibles

3 @Damage[(2d8+11)[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage

7p3yhWfqW3H1Z7e3.name: Overwhelm
7p3yhWfqW3H1Z7e3.description: The giant ant army swarms over a Large or larger creature that it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, pinning the creature in place and causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} until the start of the giant ant army's next turn or until it Escapes. A creature that begins its turn restrained by the army is repeatedly stung by the clinging ants, automatically taking @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage and suffering the effects of giant ant venom.

Wight Battalion.name: Wight Battalion
Wight Battalion.description: Wights are malevolent undead, bent on desecrating the holy and determined to cause suffering to all living creatures. A lone wight is dangerous enough, but when compelled to act together, they are a force to be reckoned with. A wight battalion has the potential to curse entire armies, increasing their numbers until they become an unholy tide.

lctO2P0MLVpB9WYB.name: Final Grudge
lctO2P0MLVpB9WYB.description:
Trigger The wight battalion is about to lose a segment due to Hit Point damage

Effect The wights strike out as they fall. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] takes @Damage[2d4[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] save). This occurs before the battalion loses a segment.

i2hz3lKfdVEcYptB.name: Fueled by Spite
i2hz3lKfdVEcYptB.description:
Each time a creature loses Hit Points due to the wight battalion's corrupting spite curse, the battalion gains 6 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.yeK8zmBJvam75Fp7]{Effect: Fueled by Spite}

Ze7HYEJOg83Kkcje.name: Corrupting Spite
Ze7HYEJOg83Kkcje.description:
The wight battalion's attacks inflict a curse that makes a creature grow weak and spiteful. A living humanoid that dies while under this curse rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.DBTbqI9QQRtlJwWh]{Wight} after [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}, controlled by the wight battalion that inflicted the curse. This new wight can't inflict corrupting spite and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. If the creating wight battalion dies or after roughly a month of existence, the new wight becomes autonomous and becomes a normal wight

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and doesn't treat any creatures as allies (1 round)

Stage 3 As stage 2, except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round)

Stage 4 As stage 2, except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4} (1 round).

JZsyW5yBoBlflI3F.name: Hateful Daggers
JZsyW5yBoBlflI3F.description:
The wights coordinate melee attacks with the daggers they were buried with. Each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] attempts a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions. On a failed save, the creature is also exposed to corrupting spite.

1 @Damage[2d4[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(4d4+8)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(4d4+14)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

Skeleton Mob.name: Skeleton Mob
Skeleton Mob.description: To the morbid, a battlefield is no more than a garden of corpses. Sometimes, either through the magic of a necromancer or through an unfortunate pooling of void energy, these bodies rise up as broken and battered skeletons. While some of these skeletons are far from whole, they can still pose a significant threat.

dsHzY2PK1f58ohEV.name: Ossuary Storm
dsHzY2PK1f58ohEV.description: The skeleton mob hurls skulls and fragments of bone in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 30 feet. This attack deals @Damage[3d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the skeleton mob is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

lNAVyJ6NEXycS9N0.name: Rattling Bones
lNAVyJ6NEXycS9N0.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The skeletons engage using their claws and broken bones to attack each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d4+1)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d4+7)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(3d4+10)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

Vordine Legion.name: Vordine Legion
Vordine Legion.description: Vordines are the foot soldiers of Hell, dispatched in vast armies from the iron city of Dis to guard Hell's uppermost layers and crush the enemies of the archdevils who rule there. Indefatigable and pitiless, a legion of vordines strikes with a ruthless precision that commands fear and envy throughout the multiverse in equal measure. Although they usually serve at the command of more powerful devils, such as the tyrannical nessari, every legion also observes a unique internal hierarchy that enables another vordine to assume command at a moment's notice should it become necessary.

tRuKD4xUouitV2n4.name: Reactive Attack
tRuKD4xUouitV2n4.description:
Trigger A creature within the vordine legion's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect The creature takes @Damage[(2d8+11)[piercing]|options:area-damage|traits:magical,unholy] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save); this damage has the magical and unholy traits. If the creature critically fails its saving throw and the trigger was a manipulate action, the legion disrupts that action.

yzekhn0KtjihD2E8.name: Burning March
yzekhn0KtjihD2E8.description: The vordine legion Strides, leaving an orderly pattern of burning hoofprints in each square they enter. The hoofprints continue to burn for 1 minute. Any creature on the ground that begins its turn in, or enters a square with, burning hoofprints takes @Damage[2d8[fire]] damage.

1xgyAsJKi4uaGNXT.name: Impaling Barrage
1xgyAsJKi4uaGNXT.description: The vordine legion releases a hail of tridents. This hail is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 40 feet that deals @Damage[4d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save). Creatures that fail the saving throw are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of the vordine legion's next turn (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure). When the vordines are reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

jWsj5fbvx0llQW2b.name: Tines of Dis
jWsj5fbvx0llQW2b.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The vordines of the legion make coordinated melee attacks with their tridents. Each enemy within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d8+2)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+11)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(3d8+14)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

Apprentice Magician Clique.name: Apprentice Magician Clique
Apprentice Magician Clique.description: Students at academies that teach magic sometimes form fast friendships. When not studying or blowing off steam together, these cliques might be called to defend their place of learning from outside attack.

298SOrPtZWcvtOhq.name: Barrage of Force
298SOrPtZWcvtOhq.description: The apprentice magicians launch shards of pure magic at all creatures in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 120 feet. This barrage deals @Damage[5d4[force]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] save). When the clique is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

zr4cOSOQ86KFbjyD.name: Clique Spellcasting
zr4cOSOQ86KFbjyD.description: When the apprentice magician clique Casts a Spell, its members pool their arcane power into the spell. A creature who critically fails their save against the spell or whom the clique hits with a critical spell attack is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

bbuOUmrCvWVMuNcJ.name: Sparking Wands
bbuOUmrCvWVMuNcJ.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The apprentice magicians wave wands that shoot out minor bolts of electricity at short range. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+3)[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(2d8+7)[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage

PAVLwZnLqEhiWI7u.name: Mass Rejuvenation
PAVLwZnLqEhiWI7u.description: This functions similarly to a lich's rejuvenation ability, though with all the liches of a legion returning as a troop thanks to a collective @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qFVPeeJ70B1u2n81]{Soul Cage}, which is a level 18 item that has Hardness 15 and 54 Hit Points.

qXZ45E5MWpjGvtE7.name: Troop Counterspell
qXZ45E5MWpjGvtE7.description:
Trigger A creature within the legion's sight casts a spell the legion has prepared

Effect The lich legion expends a prepared spell to counter the triggering creature's casting of that same spell. The lich legion loses the spell slot as if they had cast the triggering spell. The lich legion then attempts to counteract the triggering spell with a +2 status bonus to the counteract check.

zNngRDMNalyBs1dp.name: Siphoning Grip
zNngRDMNalyBs1dp.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The lich legion touches all enemies within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] to drain their life (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic|options:area-effect] save). The damage depends on the number of actions. For each action the lich legion uses, the legion gains 10 temporary Hit Points that last 1 minute.

1 @Damage[2d8[void]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(4d8+11)[void]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(6d8+13)[void]|options:area-damage] damage

A4OVN3F7XvIf893o.name: Steady Troop Spellcasting
A4OVN3F7XvIf893o.description:
When the lich legion Casts a Spell, their constituent members combine their efforts into casting a more powerful version of the spell than any one member could achieve alone. When Casting a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

If a reaction would disrupt the lich legion's spellcasting action, the lich legion attempts a @Check[flat|dc:12]. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.

Ra4zH2Y2fsG6xxMp.name: Brutal Retaliation
Ra4zH2Y2fsG6xxMp.description:
Trigger The fleshwarp amalgam loses a segment due to passing a Hit Point threshold

Effect The fleshwarp amalgam lashes out in retaliation. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] takes @Damage[2d10+6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:forced-movement]). A creature who fails the save is also pushed 5 feet away from the amalgam.

AhZyxStzEuZNYrN6.name: Acid Spray
AhZyxStzEuZNYrN6.description: The fleshwarp amalgam sprays acid from their various orifices, combining the streams into a powerful spray. This acid spray is a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] that deals @Damage[3d8[acid]|options:area-damage|options:area-effect] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save) within 60 feet. A creature who critically fails their saving throw takes @Damage[1d8[persistent,acid]|options:area-damage] damage. When the troop is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

mwaDMdReJdQ1woD5.name: Frenzy of Tentacles and Claws
mwaDMdReJdQ1woD5.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The fleshwarps make wild melee attacks against each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic|options:area-effect] save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d10[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage

wLxpfofh7JpuGaBx.name: Many-Limbed Stride
wLxpfofh7JpuGaBx.description: While moving on land, the fleshwarp amalgam ignores the effects of non-magical difficult terrain.

Arboreal Copse.name: Arboreal Copse
Arboreal Copse.description: Though arboreal wardens typically remain within the boundaries of the forests they protect, they occasionally gather into copses to seek information about potential threats to report back to arboreal regents. Arboreals are typically slow to act, but copses must sometimes make quick judgment calls when faced with imminent dangers.

uvjlEBAqOy2l2myB.name: Reactive Attack
uvjlEBAqOy2l2myB.description:
Trigger An enemy within 5 feet of the arboreal copse uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect The arboreals swing their stone swords. The triggering enemy takes @Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). If the creature critically fails their saving throw and the trigger was a manipulate action, the troop disrupts that action.

rcGFpY9bZDxpvUJ2.name: Raise Shields
rcGFpY9bZDxpvUJ2.description: The arboreal wardens of the copse raise their shields in tandem, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves.

BVopnCZzSNujoI5t.name: Shoving Shield Wall
BVopnCZzSNujoI5t.description: The arboreal copse Strides. All enemies whose square the copse begins in or passes through during their movement take @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:forced-movement]). On a failed saving throw, the arboreal copse carries the creature along on their shields, moving them in the same distance and direction for the rest of their Stride.

AwWx7DridTlHkpo8.name: Sword Bash
AwWx7DridTlHkpo8.description:
The arboreal copse uses their blunt stone longswords to pummel its foes. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d8+1)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(3d8+10)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage

Dwarf Longshot Squad (Guns).name: Dwarf Longshot Squad (Guns)
Dwarf Longshot Squad (Guns).description:
While many dwarves train to master hammers and shields, others seek to become masters of ranged weapons, usually sturdy and dwarven-built crossbows. Dwarven armies employ longshot squads as the first line of defense, especially outside of cramped tunnels and subterranean caverns.

Longshot with Guns

Dwarves from Dongun Hold and similar places have access to firearms, and you might choose to reflect this by giving the dwarf longshot squad rifles. Adjust the stat block to have the uncommon trait and replace mentions of "crossbows" to "rifles" and "bolts" to "bullets." In addition, give the Bolts from the Blue action the concussive trait, meaning that it deals bludgeoning or piercing damage, whichever would be more detrimental to each target (you may also want to refer to it as "Bullets from the Blue"). Finally, replace Hampering Fusillade with the following ability.

Bullet Smog 2 The dwarven longshots fire their rifles in rapid succession to create a cloud of smoke within 120 feet. This cloud is a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] and lasts for 1 minute or until it is dispersed by a strong wind, whichever comes first. All creatures within the cloud become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within it.

cE3nGCXUZ43jjTq2.name: Brandish Bayonets!
cE3nGCXUZ43jjTq2.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Using blades attached to their rifles, the dwarven longshots engages in a coordinated melee attack against enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5], with a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d8+2)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

2 @Damage[(2d8+11)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

3 @Damage[(3d8+13)[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage

vTdnKvhxzs5uAmUE.name: Bullet Smog
vTdnKvhxzs5uAmUE.description: The dwarven longshots fire their rifles in rapid succession to create a cloud of smoke within 120 feet. This cloud is a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] and lasts for 1 minute or until it is dispersed by a strong wind, whichever comes first. All creatures within the cloud become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within it.

EONX1OgwRhf35gSm.name: Bullets from the Blue
EONX1OgwRhf35gSm.description: The dwarven longshots reload their rifles, then launch a ranged attack in the form of a volley. This volley is a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] within 120 feet that deals @Damage[6d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] saving throw. When the dwarven longshot squad is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:10].
